subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

In the theatre, the audience threw flowers on the screen.

options.text: In the theatre, flowers were thrown by the audience.
In the theatre, flowers had been thrown by the audience.
In the theatre, flowers was thrown by the audience.
In the theatre, flowers are thrown by the audience.

solution:
The correct answer is** 'In the theatre, the audience threw flowers on the screen.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case) + was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)*
 
• *They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'the audience'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is 'Flowers. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'threw' will be changed into 'were thrown'. 
 
• Lastly, the preposition 'by' will be added.

 

Correct Sentence:__ *In the theatre, flowers were thrown by the audience.*
